title: Sources: Dave Brown, outgoing SVP of AWS Compute, AI, and Platform, will join Meta in the coming weeks; he will work on the company's data center build-out (Anissa Gardizy/Wall Street Journal)
summary: Anissa Gardizy / Wall Street Journal: Sources: Dave Brown, outgoing SVP of AWS Compute, AI, and Platform, will join Meta in the coming weeks; he will work on the company's data center build-out — The social media giant's ambitions in developing data centers and computing resources are growing
